```{r}
#| label: setup
res_dir <- "../results"
tab <- function(f) read.delim(file.path(res_dir, "tables", f), check.names = FALSE)
fig <- function(f) file.path(res_dir, "figures", f)
cfg <- yaml::read_yaml("../config/config.yaml")

samples   <- read.delim("../data/processed/samples.tsv")
variance  <- tab("pca_variance.tsv")
filtering <- tab("filtering_summary.tsv")
clusters  <- tab("kmeans_clusters.tsv")
sig       <- tab("significant_genes.tsv")
up        <- tab("gage_upregulated_pathways.tsv")
down      <- tab("gage_downregulated_pathways.tsv")
enrich    <- tab("kegg_enrichment.tsv")
kegg_info <- readLines(file.path(res_dir, "tables", "kegg_snapshot_info.txt"))
n_gc  <- sum(samples$condition == "Ground Control")
n_flt <- sum(samples$condition == "Space Flight")
```

## Question and data

Does spaceflight change gene expression in mouse skin, and are
cholesterol-metabolism genes affected?

Data: NASA OSDR study OSD-241 (GLDS-241, Rodent Research-5), RNA-seq of femoral
skin from `r n_flt` spaceflight and `r n_gc` ground-control mice
([doi:10.26030/gfsz-c144](https://doi.org/10.26030/gfsz-c144)). The analysis
starts from GeneLab's RSEM unnormalized counts table.

## PCA and clustering

After filtering, `r filtering$genes_after_filter` of
`r filtering$genes_before_filter` genes were kept. PC1 explains
`r variance$percent_variance[1]`% and PC2 `r variance$percent_variance[2]`% of
the variance.

```{r}
#| label: fig-pca
#| fig-cap: "PCA of normalised expression, coloured by condition."
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of samples on the first two principal components, red for ground control and blue for spaceflight."
knitr::include_graphics(fig("pca.png"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-kmeans
#| tbl-cap: "K-means clusters against experimental condition."
knitr::kable(table(Condition = clusters$condition, Cluster = clusters$cluster))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-dend
#| fig-cap: "Hierarchical clustering of samples on the first two principal components."
#| fig-alt: "Dendrogram of the samples split into two coloured groups."
knitr::include_graphics(fig("hierarchical_dendrogram.png"))
```

## Differential expression

With padj < `r cfg$analysis$padj_cutoff` and |log2 fold change| >
`r cfg$analysis$lfc_cutoff`, DESeq2 finds **`r nrow(sig)` significant genes**.

```{r}
#| label: fig-volcano
#| fig-cap: "Volcano plot: log2 fold change (spaceflight vs ground) against -log10 p-value."
#| fig-alt: "Volcano-shaped scatter of all genes with significant genes highlighted."
knitr::include_graphics(fig("volcano_plot.png"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-top-genes
#| tbl-cap: "Significant genes, with gene symbols where known."
sig$symbol <- suppressMessages(AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db, sub("\\.\\d+$", "", sig$gene_id),
  "SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL"))
knitr::kable(sig[, c("gene_id", "symbol", "log2FoldChange", "padj")],
             digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Pathways

Top GAGE pathway up in spaceflight: **`r up$pathway[1]`**; top pathway down:
**`r down$pathway[1]`**. KEGG gene sets: `r kegg_info[1]`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-enrichment
#| tbl-cap: "KEGG pathways enriched among the significant genes."
if (nrow(enrich) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(enrich[, c("ID", "Description", "GeneRatio", "p.adjust")],
               digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No KEGG pathway was enriched at the chosen cutoffs.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-enrich
#| fig-cap: "Enriched KEGG pathways among the significant genes."
#| fig-alt: "Dot plot of enriched KEGG pathways coloured by adjusted p-value."
knitr::include_graphics(fig("kegg_enrichment_dotplot.png"))
```

#| label: tbl-software

pkgs <- c("edgeR", "DESeq2", "factoextra", "pheatmap", "gage", "pathview",
          "clusterProfiler", "org.Mm.eg.db")
knitr::kable(data.frame(package = pkgs,
                        version = sapply(pkgs, function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p)))),
